group: 1. Scope, authorisation and rules of engagement

items.text: Named signatory, company, dates and the validity window are recorded.
items.evidence: Signed RoE (reference only; never paste signatures into a report)

items.text: In-scope SSIDs/BSSIDs/locations and explicitly out-of-scope targets are enumerated.
items.evidence: Scope table in the report appendix

items.text: Authorised and prohibited techniques are listed per target and per time window.
Data handling: capture storage, encryption, retention and deletion date.
Stop conditions, escalation contact and rollback for intrusive tests are agreed.
items.evidence: Contact sheet; incident notes if triggered

items.text: AP inventory with BSSID, SSID, channel, band, width, vendor and frame numbers.
Security policy per BSS: AKM list, ciphers, MFPC/MFPR, WPS state, OWE.
Client inventory: identity (or randomisation flag), probes, association targets.
ESS mapping: which BSSIDs share an SSID, and which look like look-alikes.
Explicit limits of the capture (duration, channels, coverage, time reference).
items.evidence: Capture metadata (duration, channel list, clock source)

items.text: PSK/WPA2: is a handshake or PMKID obtainable, and is the passphrase auditable offline?
items.evidence: hc22000 file + hashcat output with rate/time

items.text: WPA3: is the deployment WPA3-only, transition or mixed? Is SAE enforced?
items.evidence: RSNE AKM list + client association evidence

items.text: WPS: state (enabled/disabled, locked, methods) and whether the PIN path is reachable.
items.evidence: WPS IE attributes + any authorised live test result

items.text: Legacy/weak configurations (WEP, TKIP, PSK on a WPA3 AP, open BSS) are identified and scoped.
Whether a recovered key/credential grants more than L2 access (reuse, management plane).
items.evidence: Authorised reuse test or the explicit exclusion note

items.text: PMF state per BSS (capable/required) and per client population (who negotiates it).
If authorised: whether spoofed deauth/disassoc affects clients, with effect evidence.
items.evidence: Deauth frames + client disconnect log + re-association timeline

items.text: Reason codes and SA Query behaviour analysed where PMF is present.
Availability impact described in business terms and timeboxed.
Baseline of authorised BSSIDs/IE fingerprints obtained before testing.
items.evidence: Authorised inventory (from client or previous recon)

items.text: Rogue/twin detection reasoning recorded with the signals that discriminate.
Client behaviour tested where authorised: auto-connect, PNL, certificate validation.
items.evidence: Rogue-authenticator capture or a controlled client test

items.text: Detection coverage: does WIDS/WIPS raise the rogue BSSID, and with what latency?
items.evidence: WIDS alert/log or the documented gap

items.text: Client isolation tested explicitly (client-to-client through the AP).
items.evidence: ARP/ICMP capture between two authorised clients

items.text: VLAN separation tested (L2 domain boundaries).
items.evidence: Failed/successful ARP for a host on another segment

items.text: Inter-VLAN ACL enforcement tested at protocol/port level, not with ping alone.
Guest portal reviewed: transport, token handling, bypass paths, credentials.
EAP method identified and the inner/outer identity handling reviewed.
items.evidence: EAP frames with types and identities

items.text: Client certificate validation tested (ca_cert, domain/subject match).
Credential exposure assessed (MS-CHAPv2 exposure, EAP-TLS absence, legacy methods).
items.evidence: Captured material + crack result (lab/authorised) or the control that blocked it

items.text: RADIUS integrity reviewed: Message-Authenticator, Response Authenticator, secret strength/scope.
items.evidence: Packet bytes + recomputation with the secret

items.text: Dynamic VLAN/ACL assignment verified as actually enforced.
Identity-store controls (lockout, account hygiene, monitoring) reviewed where in scope.
Every claim has a capture + hash + filter + frame numbers, or a config/log excerpt.
Tools and versions, parameters and time references are recorded per test.
Limitations and untested areas are stated explicitly.
Personal data in captures is minimised, stored securely and deleted per the RoE.
Severity derived from finding context (exploitability, impact, environment), CVSS shown as an example vector.
Remediation is specific, owned and verifiable — not 'enable security'.
Retest criteria written so a third party can execute them without you.
Executive summary contains no unverifiable claims and no jargon.
Retest executed against remediated artefacts; result recorded as pass/fail with evidence.
